protocol: From the three fixed Oct 20–Nov 18 (inclusive UTC) windows, use the latest with >=8 two-parent commits. From the immutable default SHA commits REST listing select the first 8 entries with exactly 2 parents, in returned order. Both parent directions use GitHub compare page 1 per_page=1. Filter status modified/renamed, both old and new names ending in .java. If the 300-file cap is reached on one side, an empty complete side implies zero, otherwise check the small side's origin paths in the opposite regular-blob tree. A missing/retyped path would leave that merge unresolved. Confirm all positive candidates by regular blob mode and object IDs at the selected base and both parents. Each API compare reported the same selected base in both directions. API-selected-base uniqueness, production rename heuristics, conflicts, textual eligibility, history and extracted rows not measured. This convenience sample is not unbiased; commits share dependencies. This file contains no Java content.
